Name: RRRR Jello Style Cuter Sprites
Author: AlmostMidnight
Description:
I had this mod for so long, but I just forgot to actually post it. 'Bout time I got around to it...

Similar to my other mods, to still get all the content for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893?tab=description]RRRR[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284?tab=description]Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard[/url], the mod only contains files that replace the originals. [b]If you want the original sprites back, you will need to download RRRR and Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard again.

[/b]This mod is made to be used with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23321]RRRR Nyapu Portraits[/url]﻿, but can be used without.

Installation:

1. Download Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard and/or RRRR
2. Download my mod, only pick one version. One is for Config Edition and the other for the Event Edition. If you want Normal skin instead of purple, you can find the files in Optional section.
3. Unzip the folder, you'll see [CP]Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard and Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp.
4. Drop the folders in your mod folder depending on which mods you have installed (or both if you have both RRRR and Jello's Wizard installed).
4. Replace any files and done!

Downloads.Description: Make sure to replace all the files when installing. This is the Event version of Jello's wizard, so RRRR is required!
